svg.title: v38 win: the rook is visible, its queen support is hidden
svg.desc: After White Rg7, Black can see the offered rook but not White Qg4. Black captures with Kg8g7 and loses to the hidden queen line. Kh8 was an immediate surviving reply.
svg.text: v38 win: the rook is visible, its queen support is hidden
Light circles: White pieces · Dark circles: Black pieces · ? hidden · Solid: actual move · Dotted: attacker line when visible
